What we grow and raise

  • Farm stand

    Price it

  • CSA shares

  • Pick-your-own strawberries & peaches

    Price it

  • Seasonal produce

    Tomatoes, okra, squash, field peas and sweet potatoes, each in its own Midlands month.

    Price it

From people who drove here

Sample reviews from Lexington, Irmo, Blythewood, Chapin, Cayce and Forest Acres.

4.9 stars · 212 reviews · Sample review
  • "We got to the stand at 9:40 on a Saturday in June and the peaches were still cool from the cooler. My daughter ate two in the truck before we were off the gravel."
    — Henrietta V., Lexington · Seasonal produce
  • "I was nervous about a CSA after one that buried us in kale. The half share here was tomatoes, okra, squash and one bunch of greens, with a note on how to cook them. We held two weeks for the beach with one text."
    — Leopold F., Irmo · CSA shares
  • "Eggs gathered before eight and you can tell. The yolks stand up in the pan. We grab a dozen every Wednesday on the way to work."
    — Pilar N., Forest Acres · Pasture-raised eggs
  • "Odessa texted Friday night that the strawberries were thin and to come Sunday instead. We did, and filled two gallons in forty minutes with the kids."
    — Reggie H., Blythewood · Pick-your-own strawberries & peaches
